all_event_choices.gml: var db = events_db(); var n = 0; for (var e = 0; e < array_length(db); e++) { for (var c = 0; c < array_length(db[e].choices); c++) { run_new(); global.run.scrap = 500; global.run.fuel = 9; var ch = db[e].choices[c]; if (variable_struct_exists(ch, "req")) { var ok = ch.req(); } var s = ch.act(); if (!is_string(s)) return -1; n += 1; } } return n;

locked_event_choices.gml: var db = events_db(); var n = 0; for (var e = 0; e < array_length(db); e++) { for (var c = 0; c < array_length(db[e].choices); c++) { var ch = db[e].choices[c]; if (variable_struct_exists(ch, "req")) { if (!variable_struct_exists(ch, "req_text")) return -1; n += 1; } } } return n;

walk_map.gml: run_new(); var hops = 0; var guard = 0; while (guard < 40) { guard += 1; var links = map_reachable(); if (array_length(links) == 0) break; var nxt = links[irandom(array_length(links) - 1)]; if (!map_can_travel(nxt)) break; map_travel(nxt); hops += 1; var nd = map_node(global.run.node); if (nd.kind == "fuel") { run_add_fuel(2); } } return hops;

garage_churn.gml: run_new(); var c = global.run.car; var ops = 0; for (var pass = 0; pass < 3; pass++) { while (array_length(c.facs) > 0) { var def_id = car_remove(c, 0); array_push(global.run.inv, def_id); ops += 1; } while (array_length(global.run.inv) > 0) { var did = global.run.inv[0]; array_delete(global.run.inv, 0, 1); var rot = irandom(3); var cells = shape_rotated(fac(did).cells, rot); var spot = car_find_space(c, cells); if (is_array(spot)) { car_place(c, did, spot[0], spot[1], rot); } ops += 1; } } return ops;

kill_all_facs.gml: var c = global.run.car; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(c.facs); i++) c.facs[i].hp = 0; car_enforce_power(c); car_restore_power(c); return array_length(c.facs);

empty_rig.gml: var c = global.run.car; while (array_length(c.facs) > 0) car_remove(c, 0); return array_length(c.facs);

shop_stock_ok.gml: var s = shop_stock(); for (var i = 0; i < array_length(s); i++) { if (!fac_exists(s[i])) return false; } return array_length(s) > 0;
